# Exam preparation and readiness record
Keep classroom records under the approved school process, not on the textbook site.

Practice A/B: record start and finish times, criteria met or missing, source facts used, commands addressed, unfinished parts, confidence before reviewing answers, and evidence after feedback.

Error log: original answer | cause (content, interpretation, source use, tracing, syntax or time) | explained repair | fresh retry | later retry | teacher feedback.

Two priorities: specific skill ___; chapter/task ___; next short practice ___; expected criterion ___; evidence ___; remaining uncertainty ___.

Readiness: can I follow current examination instructions, use Source Booklet facts, attempt every part, trace and label accurately, justify choices and manage time? Record demonstrated, needs retry or not yet evidenced, with examples; an arbitrary percentage cannot guarantee readiness. The teacher confirms support, access arrangements and school examination requirements. Keep revision manageable; there is no new project deadline.

Before the examination: confirm the official timetable, venue, rules and materials with the school and current SCSA instructions, including approved access arrangements. Do not infer rules from this pack or bring unauthorised notes or programs. Weeks 17–18 are the planned school examination period; the external ATAR timetable remains separate.
